glosses: A series of crises occurring at the same time.
A good valued only by how it is distributed among a population and whose value comes solely from its desirability as a status symbol.
The branch of economics that concerns the description and explanation of economic phenomena and their causal relationships
The threshold of poverty, below which one's income does not cover necessities.
A strategy of selling a good or service at a very low price so as to drive one's competitors out of business (at which point one can raise one's prices more freely).

glosses: The value of future cash flows determined as of the date of valuation.
A governmental restriction on the prices that can be charged for goods and services in a market.
To charge different prices to different categories of consumers.
The practice of charging different prices to different categories of consumers.
vi_hint: Phân biệt đối xử theo giá.

glosses: An economic metric designed to measure how sensitive quantity demanded is to a change in the price of a good/service.
vi_hint: Độ co giãn của cầu theo giá.

glosses: A statistical estimate of the level of prices of some class of goods or services.
A state of economy characterized by low inflation, and thus a stable value of money. Price stability is one of the central goals of most governments and central banks.
A situation where commercial competitors repeatedly undercut each other's prices in order to attract buyers.
An industry that processes raw materials for conversion by secondary industry into goods or services sold by tertiary industry to provide goods or services to consumers.
The sector of the economy that principally produces raw materials for use by other sectors.
To engage in deficit spending.
To give something in order to create the conditions where others will give in return.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see prime, the, pump.
A good that is rivalrous and excludable.
An item of goods, such as partly finished goods, used as an input in the production of other goods.
A price index that measures the average changes in prices received by domestic producers for their output.
Perceived differences between the product of one firm and that of its rivals so that some customers value it more.
The process of creating such differences.
